critic.fix_suggestion: Relocate the four engine geometries from their current floating positions to the underside of the wing structure. Apply a translation vector that aligns the center of each engine with the corresponding pylon location on the wing's lower surface, ensuring they are vertically aligned and spaced at 25% intervals along the wingspan.

discrepancies.observed: Four engines are floating in space away from the wing structure.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are physically attached to pylons under the wings.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach engine geometries to wing underside positions.

discrepancies.observed: The main wings appear disconnected or floating near the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Wings are structurally integrated into the lower fuselage/wing root.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and merge wing base geometry with fuselage center.

discrepancies.observed: Vertical stabilizer is detached from the rear fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Vertical stabilizer is joined to the top of the aft fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach vertical stabilizer to rear fuselage top.

discrepancies.observed: Horizontal stabilizers are floating at the tail.
discrepancies.reference: Horizontal stabilizers are attached to the base of the vertical stabilizer/rear fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach horizontal stabilizers to the tail section.
